themes.impossible_human: A recurring AI person presented as real, whose striking or odd look makes viewers ask if he or she exists
themes.machine_awakening: An AI, robot or android that seems to become conscious, unsettling or dangerous
themes.character_crossover: Recurring AI characters meeting, challenging or referencing each other across accounts
themes.lifestyle_flex: Everyday life, style, sport, travel or food shown as a real person's routine
themes.other: Anything else or not enough information

formats.docufiction_log: Fake documentary or lab log with a narrator, progress reports and staged failures
formats.street_candid: Short candid or street clip, phone-camera look, one-line caption or catchphrase
formats.selfie_talk: Character speaking to camera, vlog or selfie style
formats.teaser_reveal: Teaser, trailer or behind-the-scenes that admits or hints it is AI or CGI
formats.other: Anything else or not enough information

hooks.uncanny_face: An impossible-looking person fills the frame from the first second (striking hair, face or outfit) with no text
hooks.ai_in_real_place: An AI person or object in a recognisable real place (street, cafe, landmark) shot like a phone video
hooks.lab_log_voiceover: A robot, android or device on a desk while a narrator speaks like a work log or lab recording
hooks.creepy_glitch: Something unsettling in the first seconds: eyes, smile, voice or movement that feels wrong
hooks.explicit_is_it_real: Text, caption or speech openly asks or teases whether it is real or AI
hooks.direct_address: The character speaks straight to the camera in the first seconds
hooks.no_hook: Static title, logo, black screen or slow build with no clear hook
